title: Two City Scheduling
goal: Split an even group between two cities while keeping the combined cost low.
strategy: Rank people by how much more city B costs than city A, then fill city A with the favoured half.

phasePurposes.inspect: Compare the two costs of each person.
phasePurposes.update: Fill the first half for A and the rest for B.

edgeCases: Two people must split between cities
Equal differences admit several optimal assignments
Every person prefers A but half must go to B
inputRules: The input parser enforces the problem domain and explicit limits for an inspectable trace.
